## What Problem This Solves

Fixes healthy proxied model responses failing after 16 MiB of cumulative SSE traffic, even when every event line is small.

## User Impact

Long proxied responses can finish. Each outstanding event line remains capped at 16 MiB, oversized lines still cancel the response, and stalled reads and error bodies retain their existing limits. Accumulated assistant output can exceed 16 MiB.

## Why This Change Was Made

The existing reader now charges raw bytes to the outstanding newline-delimited line before decoding, releasing that budget after each completed line. This keeps the current line parsing and reader cleanup while removing the lifetime traffic cap. No configuration or protocol change is needed.

## Evidence

- Real loopback HTTP through `streamProxy` and native fetch: 18 MiB of small valid text deltas completes; an oversized pending line fails and closes the upstream socket. Both regressions fail on baseline `9ca7932563ff3a8d2d3eca37e50d6ea7b031a527` and pass with this change.
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/agents/runtime/proxy.test.ts -t 'accepts cumulative SSE traffic above 16 MiB over native HTTP|rejects an oversized pending SSE line and closes native HTTP' --maxWorkers=1 --reporter=verbose`: baseline 2 failed, fixed 2 passed (1.53 s wall).
- Entire named proxy test file: 24 passed (1.61 s wall), covering cancellation and reader release, terminal/error outcomes, idle deadlines, error-body bounds, and split Unicode input. Touched-file type-aware lint, formatting, and `git diff --check` pass.
- Independent isolated autoreview of the final diff and complete owner/test composition: no actionable P0–P3 findings.
- [Exact-target build](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/43272522067/job/131373637153) passed for `cd7876e6369c5282adc820468a0acc5120b418b9`, verified from the build checkout log. [Ready-PR CI 43278944992](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/43278944992) passed at the same exact head, including security-fast and the required CI gate. The workflow revision of the earlier manual run is not the tested candidate revision. No live provider was used.

The earlier broad manual run 43272522067 also reported unrelated-area failures: four jobs have matching baseline signatures, one has mixed attribution, and seven remain unclassified. The later ready-PR run passing does not establish that those earlier failures were repaired or inherited. No unrelated source, test ceiling, or gate was changed.
